The Partner Support Team Leader – Frontline leads a team of Advisors who support our partners across phone, chat, email and WhatsApp. You’ll make sure every partner gets fast, accurate and personal support, and an experience that exceeds their expectations.

You’ll develop your people, deliver your team’s performance targets, and help bring Partner Support’s key initiatives, including AI and automation, to life on the frontline.

Deliver an exceptional partner experience

  • Make sure every partner gets fast, accurate and personal support that exceeds their expectations.

  • Shift the team from reactive to proactive support, spotting partner needs before they become issues.

  • Own frontline escalations through to resolution, keeping partners informed at every step.

  • Raise incidents quickly when contact spikes signal a platform issue, and hand complex technical issues to Tech Operations with full context, following through until the partner is updated.

Lead and develop the team

  • Lead, motivate and develop Advisors through regular 1:1s, side-by-side coaching and clear development plans.

  • Set clear goals and expectations and manage performance fairly, recognising strong performance and addressing gaps early through improvement plans where needed.

  • Manage attendance, punctuality, leave and absence.

  • Use quality results, calibration sessions and insights from the Quality team to find skill gaps and focus coaching and refresher training where it matters most.

  • Build a culture of ownership, accountability and continuous improvement, keeping the team engaged and attrition low.

  • Take part in hiring and onboarding new Advisors.

  • Identify and grow future Team Leaders and subject-matter experts.

  • Run the daily frontline operation: huddles, shift handovers, real-time queue monitoring and moving Advisors between channels and queues to protect service level.

  • Manage schedules, breaks and schedule adherence in line with the WFM plan.

  • Make sure Advisors follow SOPs, policies, tagging and case-handling standards.

  • Feed AI failures, knowledge gaps and partner feedback back to improve AI, workflows and knowledge.

  • Share updates, product changes and priorities with the team, and work closely with WFM, Quality, Training and other teams.
